title: Seagrove "Our Southern Charm" 701 Eastern Lake Road Lower Level
h1: Seagrove "Our Southern Charm" 701 Eastern Lake Road Lower Level
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gulf-front- Private beach access- Complimentary beach setups each morning include 2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella (Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31)- Professionally decorated- 3 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Enjoy the coastal elegance and beachfront luxury of "Our Southern Charm"! The lower level of this gorgeous, gulf-facing home offers 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, stunning interiors, private beach access, breathtaking panoramic Emerald Coast views, and incredible accommodations for 8 guests!Guests are welcomed into the home's main level with a jewel-toned ocean view, lots of natural light, and soft, neutral decor elements. The open layout seamlessly connects the main living, dining, and kitchen areas. Professionally decorated interiors create a warm and inviting ambiance and set the stage for a relaxing getaway. The living room's plush furnishings make the perfect place to sink down in front of the mounted flat-screen television. Bright white cabinets and a white tile backsplash amplify the natural light in the gorgeous kitchen. The chefs in your group will undoubtedly love preparing fresh, coastal meals in this space, which offers top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, a beautiful farmhouse sink, and lots of countertop space. The breakfast bar creates the perfect place for others to gather over appetizers and entertain the cooks as they work. Guests can enjoy 3 seats at the breakfast bar and 6 additional seats at the adjacent dining table. Sliding glass doors lead to the spacious back deck, which provides a place to enjoy the rejuvenating beach views with a morning coffee or a favorite evening cocktail.This level offers 3 gorgeous bedrooms with various sleeping accommodations that are sure to please everyone in your group. Guests in the primary suite will enjoy a plush queen bed, a mounted flat-screen television, beach views and direct access to the back deck, and a private bathroom with a shower and a dual-sink vanity. The second guest room offers a luxurious queen bed and a shared bathroom with a shower/tub combo. The final bedroom on this level features a cozy queen bed, a built-in twin-over-twin bunk bed, and a shared bathroom with a shower/tub combo.This home's prime location right on the beach allows your family to enjoy the sugar-white sand and sparkling emerald waters from sunrise to sunset. Enjoy dinners al fresco on the first-floor porch while waves provide the background music. Three custom 360 Blue adult beach cruiser bikes offer the perfect way to explore Seagrove and all of the incredible local dining, shopping, and entertainment options in our amazing 30A coastal towns. Plan your stay in and to experience the lower level of "Our Southern Charm"!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSFIRST FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed with Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboParties, weddings or events held at the property must be pre-approved in writing by 360 Blue. Fees apply. Contact us for additional details.
